local network = require("link_network")
local M = {}
local names = {[1] = "A", [2] = "NS", [5] = "CNAME", [6] = "SOA", [12] = "PTR", [15] = "MX", [16] = "TXT", [28] = "AAAA"}
function M.type_name(value)
    return names[value] or "TYPE" .. value
end
function M.rcode_name(value)
    return ({"NoError", "FormErr", "ServFail", "NXDomain", "NotImp", "Refused"})[value + 1] or "RCODE" .. value
end
local function label_text(data)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, #data do
        local value = data:byte(i)
        result[i] = value >= 33 and value <= 126 and value ~= 46 and value ~= 92 and string.char(value) or string.format("\\%03d", value)
    end
    return table.concat(result)
end
local function ipv6(data)
    local groups, texts, start, length, index = {}, {}, nil, 1, 1
    for i = 1, 8 do
        groups[i] = network.integer(data, 2 * (i - 1), 2)
        texts[i] = string.format("%x", groups[i])
    end
    while index <= 8 do
        if groups[index] ~= 0 then
            index = index + 1
        else
            local last = index
            while last <= 8 and groups[last] == 0 do
                last = last + 1
            end
            if last - index > length then
                start, length = index, last - index
            end
            index = last
        end
    end
    if not start then
        return table.concat(texts, ":")
    end
    return table.concat(texts, ":", 1, start - 1) .. "::" .. table.concat(texts, ":", start + length, 8)
end
local Reader = {}
Reader.__index = Reader
function Reader:chunk(position, size)
    if position + size > #self.data then
        error("dns: truncated", 0)
    end
    return self.data:sub(position + 1, position + size)
end
function Reader:integer(position, size)
    return network.integer(self:chunk(position, size), 0, size)
end
function Reader:name(position)
    local labels, pointers, after = {}, 0, nil
    while true do
        local size = self:integer(position, 1)
        if size == 0 then
            after = after or position + 1
            break
        elseif size >= 192 then
            local low = self:integer(position + 1, 1)
            after, pointers = after or position + 2, pointers + 1
            if pointers > 16 then
                error("dns: compression loop", 0)
            end
            position = (size - 192) * 256 + low
            if position >= #self.data then
                error("dns: pointer out of range", 0)
            end
        elseif size >= 64 then
            error("dns: bad label type", 0)
        else
            labels[#labels + 1] = label_text(self:chunk(position + 1, size))
            position = position + size + 1
        end
    end
    return #labels > 0 and table.concat(labels, ".") or "<root>", after
end
function Reader:rdata(kind, start, size)
    if kind == 1 then
        return network.ipv4(self:integer(start, 4)), start + 4
    end
    if kind == 28 then
        return ipv6(self:chunk(start, 16)), start + 16
    end
    if kind == 2 or kind == 5 or kind == 12 then
        return self:name(start)
    end
    if kind == 15 then
        local preference = self:integer(start, 2)
        local name, after = self:name(start + 2)
        return preference .. " " .. name, after
    end
    if kind == 6 then
        local primary, after = self:name(start)
        local mailbox
        mailbox, after = self:name(after)
        local parts = {primary, mailbox}
        for _ = 1, 5 do
            parts[#parts + 1] = self:integer(after, 4)
            after = after + 4
        end
        return table.concat(parts, " "), after
    end
    return size .. " bytes", start + size
end
function Reader:record(position, section, layer)
    local name, after = self:name(position)
    local fixed = self:chunk(after, 10)
    local kind, class, ttl, size = network.integer(fixed, 0, 2), network.integer(fixed, 2, 2), network.integer(fixed, 4, 4), network.integer(fixed, 8, 2)
    local start = after + 10
    self:chunk(start, size)
    local body, finish = self:rdata(kind, start, size)
    if finish ~= start + size then
        error("dns: bad rdata length", 0)
    end
    local class_name = class == 1 and "IN" or "CLASS" .. class
    layer:add(section, table.concat({name, M.type_name(kind), class_name, ttl, body}, " "))
    if section == "dns.answer" then
        layer.answers[#layer.answers + 1] = M.type_name(kind) .. " " .. body
        if kind == 1 then
            layer:add("dns.a", self:integer(start, 4))
        end
    end
    return start + size
end
function M.dissect(data)
    local reader, layer = setmetatable({data = data}, Reader), network.layer()
    reader:chunk(0, 12)
    local flags, counts = reader:integer(2, 2), {}
    layer:set("dns.id", reader:integer(0, 2))
    layer:set("dns.flags", flags)
    layer:set("dns.flags.response", flags // 32768 % 2)
    layer:set("dns.flags.opcode", flags // 2048 % 16)
    layer:set("dns.flags.rcode", flags % 16)
    for i, name in ipairs({"queries", "answers", "auth_rr", "add_rr"}) do
        counts[i] = reader:integer(2 + 2 * i, 2)
        layer:set("dns.count." .. name, counts[i])
    end
    local position = 12
    for _ = 1, counts[1] do
        local name
        name, position = reader:name(position)
        local tail = reader:chunk(position, 4)
        layer:add("dns.qry.name", name)
        layer:add("dns.qry.type", network.integer(tail, 0, 2))
        position = position + 4
    end
    layer.answers = {}
    for i, section in ipairs({"dns.answer", "dns.authority", "dns.additional"}) do
        for _ = 1, counts[i + 1] do
            position = reader:record(position, section, layer)
        end
    end
    return layer
end
return M

local M = {marks = {"retransmission", "out_of_order", "lost_segment", "duplicate_ack"}}
function M.power2(exponent)
    local value = 1
    for _ = 1, exponent do
        value = value * 2
    end
    return value
end
local function endpoint(address, port)
    return {address = address, port = port}
end
local function endpoint_key(value)
    return value.address .. ":" .. (value.port or "")
end
local function pair_key(a, b)
    local first, second = endpoint_key(a), endpoint_key(b)
    if first > second then
        first, second = second, first
    end
    return first .. "|" .. second
end
local function side(name)
    return {name = name, intervals = {}, packets = 0, payload = 0, marks = {retransmission = 0, out_of_order = 0, lost_segment = 0, duplicate_ack = 0}}
end
local function record_syn(stream, sender, packet)
    sender.isn, sender.mss, sender.wscale = packet:value("tcp.seq_raw"), packet:value("tcp.options.mss"), packet:value("tcp.options.wscale")
    if sender.name == "client" then
        stream.syn = packet.number
    else
        stream.syn_ack = packet.number
    end
end
local Tracker = {}
Tracker.__index = Tracker
function M.tracker()
    return setmetatable({streams = {}, latest = {}, duplicates = {}}, Tracker)
end
function Tracker:track(packet)
    local source = endpoint(packet:value("ip.src"), packet:value("tcp.srcport"))
    local destination = endpoint(packet:value("ip.dst"), packet:value("tcp.dstport"))
    local seq, ack, window, size = packet:value("tcp.seq_raw"), packet:value("tcp.ack_raw"), packet:value("tcp.window"), packet:value("tcp.len")
    local syn, fin, rst, has_ack = packet:value("tcp.flags.syn") == 1, packet:value("tcp.flags.fin") == 1, packet:value("tcp.flags.rst") == 1, packet:value("tcp.flags.ack") == 1
    local key = pair_key(source, destination)
    local stream = self.latest[key]
    if not stream or (stream.state == "CLOSED" or stream.state == "RESET") and syn and not has_ack then
        local state, client, server = "ESTABLISHED", source, destination
        if syn and has_ack then
            state, client, server = "SYN_RECEIVED", destination, source
        elseif syn then
            state = "SYN_SENT"
        end
        stream = {number = #self.streams, client = client, server = server, state = state, history = {{state, packet.number}}, start = packet.time, finish = packet.time, packets = 0, bytes = 0, events = {}, client_side = side("client"), server_side = side("server")}
        if syn then
            record_syn(stream, has_ack and stream.server_side or stream.client_side, packet)
        end
        self.streams[#self.streams + 1], self.latest[key] = stream, stream
    end
    local sender, other = stream.client_side, stream.server_side
    if endpoint_key(source) ~= endpoint_key(stream.client) then
        sender, other = other, sender
    end
    packet:set("tcp.stream", stream.number)
    if sender.base == nil then
        sender.base = seq
    end
    if has_ack and other.base == nil then
        other.base = ack
    end
    local relative = (seq - sender.base) % 4294967296
    packet:set("tcp.seq", relative)
    if has_ack then
        packet:set("tcp.ack", (ack - other.base) % 4294967296)
    end
    local span, mark = size + (syn and 1 or 0) + (fin and 1 or 0), nil
    if span > 0 then
        local interval = relative .. "," .. span
        if sender.expected ~= nil and relative ~= sender.expected then
            if relative > sender.expected then
                mark = "lost_segment"
            elseif sender.intervals[interval] then
                mark = "retransmission"
            elseif packet.time - sender.advanced_at < 3000 then
                mark = "out_of_order"
            else
                mark = "retransmission"
            end
        end
        sender.intervals[interval] = true
        if sender.expected == nil or relative + span > sender.expected then
            sender.expected, sender.advanced_at = relative + span, packet.time
        end
    elseif has_ack and not rst then
        local previous = sender.previous_ack
        if previous and previous.ack == ack and previous.window == window then
            mark, previous.count = "duplicate_ack", previous.count + 1
            self.duplicates[packet.number] = {previous.number, previous.count}
        end
    end
    if has_ack and mark ~= "duplicate_ack" then
        sender.previous_ack = {ack = ack, window = window, number = packet.number, count = 0}
    end
    if mark then
        packet:set("tcp.analysis." .. mark, true)
        sender.marks[mark] = sender.marks[mark] + 1
        stream.events[#stream.events + 1] = {packet.number, sender.name, mark, relative, span}
    end
    local calculated = window
    if stream.client_side.wscale ~= nil and stream.server_side.wscale ~= nil and not syn then
        calculated = window * M.power2(sender.wscale)
    end
    packet:set("tcp.window.calc", calculated)
    local old = stream.state
    if rst then
        if old ~= "CLOSED" and old ~= "RESET" then
            stream.state = "RESET"
        end
    elseif old == "SYN_SENT" and sender.name == "server" and syn and has_ack and ack == (stream.client_side.isn + 1) % 4294967296 then
        stream.state = "SYN_RECEIVED"
        record_syn(stream, stream.server_side, packet)
    elseif old == "SYN_RECEIVED" and sender.name == "client" and has_ack and not syn and ack == (stream.server_side.isn + 1) % 4294967296 then
        stream.state, stream.handshake_ack = "ESTABLISHED", packet.number
    elseif old == "ESTABLISHED" and fin then
        stream.state, stream.closer = "FIN_WAIT", sender.name
    elseif old == "FIN_WAIT" and fin and sender.name ~= stream.closer then
        stream.state, stream.final_ack = "CLOSING", (seq + size + 1) % 4294967296
    elseif old == "CLOSING" and sender.name == stream.closer and has_ack and ack == stream.final_ack then
        stream.state = "CLOSED"
    end
    if stream.state ~= old then
        stream.history[#stream.history + 1] = {stream.state, packet.number}
    end
    sender.packets, sender.payload = sender.packets + 1, sender.payload + size
    stream.packets, stream.bytes, stream.finish = stream.packets + 1, stream.bytes + packet.length, packet.time
end
local function totals(row)
    row.packets = row.packets_a_to_b + row.packets_b_to_a
    row.bytes = row.bytes_a_to_b + row.bytes_b_to_a
end
function M.conversations(packets)
    local result, by_key = {}, {}
    for _, packet in ipairs(packets) do
        if packet:exists("ip.src") then
            local a, b = packet:value("ip.src"), packet:value("ip.dst")
            local views = {{kind = "ipv4", source = endpoint(a), destination = endpoint(b)}}
            if packet:exists("tcp.stream") then
                views[#views + 1] = {kind = "tcp", key = tostring(packet:value("tcp.stream")), source = endpoint(a, packet:value("tcp.srcport")), destination = endpoint(b, packet:value("tcp.dstport"))}
            end
            if packet:exists("udp.srcport") then
                views[#views + 1] = {kind = "udp", source = endpoint(a, packet:value("udp.srcport")), destination = endpoint(b, packet:value("udp.dstport"))}
            end
            for _, view in ipairs(views) do
                local key = view.kind .. "|" .. (view.key or pair_key(view.source, view.destination))
                local row = by_key[key]
                if not row then
                    row = {kind = view.kind, source = view.source, destination = view.destination, first = packet.number, start = packet.time, finish = packet.time, packets_a_to_b = 0, bytes_a_to_b = 0, packets_b_to_a = 0, bytes_b_to_a = 0}
                    result[#result + 1], by_key[key] = row, row
                end
                local direction = endpoint_key(view.source) == endpoint_key(row.source) and "a_to_b" or "b_to_a"
                row["packets_" .. direction] = row["packets_" .. direction] + 1
                row["bytes_" .. direction] = row["bytes_" .. direction] + packet.length
                row.finish = packet.time
                totals(row)
            end
        end
    end
    local kinds = {ipv4 = 1, tcp = 2, udp = 3}
    table.sort(result, function(a, b)
        if a.bytes ~= b.bytes then
            return a.bytes > b.bytes
        end
        if a.packets ~= b.packets then
            return a.packets > b.packets
        end
        if a.kind ~= b.kind then
            return kinds[a.kind] < kinds[b.kind]
        end
        return a.first < b.first
    end)
    return result
end
function M.endpoints(packets)
    local by_ip = {}
    local function entry(address)
        if not by_ip[address] then
            by_ip[address] = {address = address, tx_packets = 0, tx_bytes = 0, rx_packets = 0, rx_bytes = 0}
        end
        return by_ip[address]
    end
    for _, packet in ipairs(packets) do
        if packet:exists("ip.src") then
            local a, b = entry(packet:value("ip.src")), entry(packet:value("ip.dst"))
            a.tx_packets, a.tx_bytes = a.tx_packets + 1, a.tx_bytes + packet.length
            b.rx_packets, b.rx_bytes = b.rx_packets + 1, b.rx_bytes + packet.length
        end
    end
    local result = {}
    for _, row in pairs(by_ip) do
        row.packets, row.bytes = row.tx_packets + row.rx_packets, row.tx_bytes + row.rx_bytes
        result[#result + 1] = row
    end
    table.sort(result, function(a, b)
        if a.bytes ~= b.bytes then
            return a.bytes > b.bytes
        end
        if a.packets ~= b.packets then
            return a.packets > b.packets
        end
        return a.address < b.address
    end)
    return result
end
return M

local M = {}
local Packet = {}
Packet.__index = Packet
function Packet:set(name, value)
    self.fields[name] = {value}
end
function Packet:add(name, value)
    local values = self.fields[name] or {}
    values[#values + 1] = value
    self.fields[name] = values
end
function Packet:values(name)
    return self.fields[name] or {}
end
function Packet:value(name)
    return self.fields[name] and self.fields[name][1]
end
function Packet:exists(name)
    return self.fields[name] ~= nil
end
function M.read_lines(path)
    local file, result = assert(io.open(path)), {}
    for line in file:lines() do
        result[#result + 1] = line
    end
    file:close()
    return result
end
local function read_data(packet, lines)
    local pieces, count = {}, 0
    for _, row in ipairs(lines) do
        local offset, body = row.text:match("^([0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f])  (.+)$")
        local valid = body ~= nil and #body >= 2 and #body <= 47 and (#body + 1) % 3 == 0
        local bytes = {}
        if valid then
            for i = 1, #body, 3 do
                local value = body:sub(i, i + 1)
                if not value:match("^[0-9a-f][0-9a-f]$") or i + 2 <= #body and body:sub(i + 2, i + 2) ~= " " then
                    valid = false
                    break
                end
                bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(tonumber(value, 16))
            end
        end
        if not valid then
            packet.error = "dump: bad line " .. row.number
            return
        end
        if tonumber(offset, 16) ~= count then
            packet.error = "dump: offset mismatch at line " .. row.number
            return
        end
        local piece = table.concat(bytes)
        pieces[#pieces + 1], count = piece, count + #piece
    end
    if count ~= packet.length then
        packet.error = string.format("dump: length mismatch (header %d, data %d)", packet.length, count)
        return
    end
    packet.data = table.concat(pieces)
end
function M.read_capture(path)
    local packets, groups = {}, {}
    for number, line in ipairs(M.read_lines(path)) do
        if line:sub(1, 7) == "PACKET " then
            local id, time, length = line:match("^PACKET (%d+) (%d+) (%d+)$")
            packets[#packets + 1] = setmetatable({number = tonumber(id), time = tonumber(time), length = tonumber(length), data = "", fields = {}, layers = {}, remaining = ""}, Packet)
            groups[#groups + 1] = {}
        elseif line ~= "" then
            local group = groups[#groups]
            group[#group + 1] = {number = number, text = line}
        end
    end
    for i, packet in ipairs(packets) do
        read_data(packet, groups[i])
    end
    return packets
end
function M.hex_dump(data)
    local result = {}
    for offset = 0, #data - 1, 16 do
        local hex, characters = {}, {}
        for i = offset + 1, math.min(offset + 16, #data) do
            local value = data:byte(i)
            hex[#hex + 1] = string.format("%02x", value)
            characters[#characters + 1] = value >= 32 and value <= 126 and string.char(value) or "."
        end
        result[#result + 1] = string.format("%04x  %-47s  |%s|", offset, table.concat(hex, " "), table.concat(characters))
    end
    return result
end
return M

local M = {}
local Layer = {}
Layer.__index = Layer
function M.layer()
    return setmetatable({fields = {}, remaining = ""}, Layer)
end
function Layer:set(name, value)
    self.fields[name] = {value}
end
function Layer:add(name, value)
    self.fields[name] = self.fields[name] or {}
    local values = self.fields[name]
    values[#values + 1] = value
end
function Layer:forward(name, payload)
    self.next_layer, self.payload = name, payload
end
function M.integer(data, offset, size)
    local result = 0
    for i = offset + 1, offset + size do
        result = result * 256 + data:byte(i)
    end
    return result
end
function M.bytes(value, size)
    local result = {}
    for i = size, 1, -1 do
        result[i], value = string.char(value % 256), value // 256
    end
    return table.concat(result)
end
function M.checksum(data)
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, #data, 2 do
        total = total + data:byte(i) * 256 + (data:byte(i + 1) or 0)
    end
    while total > 65535 do
        total = total % 65536 + total // 65536
    end
    return total == 65535 and "good" or "bad"
end
function M.mac(value)
    local bytes, parts = M.bytes(value, 6), {}
    for i = 1, 6 do
        parts[i] = string.format("%02x", bytes:byte(i))
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ":")
end
function M.ipv4(value)
    local bytes, parts = M.bytes(value, 4), {}
    for i = 1, 4 do
        parts[i] = bytes:byte(i)
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ".")
end
function M.ethernet(data)
    if #data < 14 then
        error("eth: truncated", 0)
    end
    local layer, kind = M.layer(), M.integer(data, 12, 2)
    layer:set("eth.dst", M.integer(data, 0, 6))
    layer:set("eth.src", M.integer(data, 6, 6))
    layer:set("eth.type", kind)
    if kind == 2054 then
        layer:forward("arp", data:sub(15))
    elseif kind == 2048 then
        layer:forward("ip", data:sub(15))
    else
        layer.remaining = data:sub(15)
    end
    return layer
end
function M.arp(data)
    if #data < 28 then
        error("arp: truncated", 0)
    end
    if M.integer(data, 0, 2) ~= 1 or M.integer(data, 2, 2) ~= 2048 or data:byte(5) ~= 6 or data:byte(6) ~= 4 then
        error("arp: unsupported format", 0)
    end
    local layer = M.layer()
    for _, item in ipairs({{"opcode", 6, 2}, {"src.hw", 8, 6}, {"src.ip", 14, 4}, {"dst.hw", 18, 6}, {"dst.ip", 24, 4}}) do
        layer:set("arp." .. item[1], M.integer(data, item[2], item[3]))
    end
    return layer
end
function M.ipv4_layer(data)
    if #data < 20 then
        error("ip: truncated header", 0)
    end
    local version, header = data:byte(1) // 16, data:byte(1) % 16 * 4
    if version ~= 4 then
        error("ip: bad version " .. version, 0)
    end
    if header < 20 then
        error("ip: bad header length " .. header, 0)
    end
    if #data < header then
        error("ip: truncated header", 0)
    end
    local total = M.integer(data, 2, 2)
    if total < header then
        error("ip: bad total length " .. total, 0)
    end
    if total > #data then
        error(string.format("ip: truncated (total length %d, available %d)", total, #data), 0)
    end
    local flags, protocol, layer = M.integer(data, 6, 2), data:byte(10), M.layer()
    layer:set("ip.hdr_len", header)
    layer:set("ip.tos", data:byte(2))
    layer:set("ip.len", total)
    layer:set("ip.id", M.integer(data, 4, 2))
    layer:set("ip.flags.df", flags // 16384 % 2)
    layer:set("ip.flags.mf", flags // 8192 % 2)
    layer:set("ip.frag_offset", flags % 8192 * 8)
    layer:set("ip.ttl", data:byte(9))
    layer:set("ip.proto", protocol)
    layer:set("ip.checksum", M.integer(data, 10, 2))
    layer:set("ip.checksum.status", M.checksum(data:sub(1, header)))
    layer:set("ip.src", M.integer(data, 12, 4))
    layer:set("ip.dst", M.integer(data, 16, 4))
    local payload = data:sub(header + 1, total)
    if flags // 8192 % 2 == 1 or flags % 8192 ~= 0 then
        layer:set("ip.fragment", true)
        layer.remaining = payload
    else
        local next_layer = ({[1] = "icmp", [17] = "udp", [6] = "tcp"})[protocol]
        if next_layer then
            layer:forward(next_layer, payload)
        else
            layer.remaining = payload
        end
    end
    return layer
end
return M

local hexdump = require("hexdump")
local network = require("link_network")
local transport = require("transport")
local dns = require("dns_app")
local flows = require("flows")
local fields = {
    {"frame.number", "integer"},
    {"frame.time", "integer"},
    {"frame.len", "integer"},
    {"frame.protocols", "string"},
    {"frame.malformed", "string"},
    {"frame.bad_checksum", "presence"},
    {"eth.dst", "mac"},
    {"eth.src", "mac"},
    {"eth.type", "hex4"},
    {"arp.opcode", "integer"},
    {"arp.src.hw", "mac"},
    {"arp.src.ip", "ipv4"},
    {"arp.dst.hw", "mac"},
    {"arp.dst.ip", "ipv4"},
    {"ip.hdr_len", "integer"},
    {"ip.tos", "hex2"},
    {"ip.len", "integer"},
    {"ip.id", "hex4"},
    {"ip.flags.df", "integer"},
    {"ip.flags.mf", "integer"},
    {"ip.frag_offset", "integer"},
    {"ip.ttl", "integer"},
    {"ip.proto", "integer"},

    local lines = {"address,packets,bytes,tx_packets,tx_bytes,rx_packets,rx_bytes"}
    for _, row in ipairs(flows.endpoints(packets)) do
        lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat({network.ipv4(row.address), row.packets, row.bytes, row.tx_packets, row.tx_bytes, row.rx_packets, row.rx_bytes}, ",")
    end
    return lines
end
local function stream_lines(stream, packets)
    local history = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(stream.history) do
        history[#history + 1] = line(table.unpack(entry))
    end
    local rtt = "-"
    if stream.syn and stream.handshake_ack then
        rtt = seconds(packets[stream.handshake_ack].time - packets[stream.syn].time)
    end
    local client, server = stream.client_side, stream.server_side
    local lines = {
        line("stream", stream.number, endpoint_text(stream.client), "->", endpoint_text(stream.server)),
        line("packets", stream.packets, "bytes", stream.bytes, "start", seconds(stream.start - packets[1].time), "duration", seconds(stream.finish - stream.start)),
        "states " .. table.concat(history, ", "),
        line("handshake syn", optional(stream.syn), "syn_ack", optional(stream.syn_ack), "ack", optional(stream.handshake_ack), "rtt", rtt),
        line("options client mss", optional(client.mss), "wscale", optional(client.wscale), "server mss", optional(server.mss), "wscale", optional(server.wscale))
    }
    for _, side in ipairs({client, server}) do
        local parts = {line(side.name, "packets", side.packets, "payload", side.payload)}
        for _, mark in ipairs(flows.marks) do
            parts[#parts + 1] = line(mark, side.marks[mark])
        end
        lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat(parts, " ")
    end
    for _, event in ipairs(stream.events) do
        lines[#lines + 1] = line("event", event[1], event[2], event[3], "seq", event[4], "len", event[5])
    end
    return lines
end
local function write_lines(name, lines)
    local file = assert(io.open("output/" .. name, "w"))
    for _, text in ipairs(lines) do
        file:write(text, "\n")
    end
    file:close()
end
local packets = hexdump.read_capture("input/capture.txt")

for _, packet in ipairs(packets) do

local summaries, summary_output, detail_output = {}, {}, {}

local network = require("link_network")
local M = {}
local integer, layer = network.integer, network.layer
local function pseudo(source, destination, protocol, size)
    return network.bytes(source, 4) .. network.bytes(destination, 4) .. string.char(0, protocol) .. network.bytes(size, 2)
end
function M.icmp(data)
    if #data < 8 then
        error("icmp: truncated", 0)
    end
    local result, kind = layer(), data:byte(1)
    result:set("icmp.type", kind)
    result:set("icmp.code", data:byte(2))
    result:set("icmp.checksum", integer(data, 2, 2))
    result:set("icmp.checksum.status", network.checksum(data))
    if kind == 0 or kind == 8 then
        result:set("icmp.id", integer(data, 4, 2))
        result:set("icmp.seq", integer(data, 6, 2))
    end
    result.remaining = data:sub(9)
    return result
end
function M.udp(data, source, destination)
    if #data < 8 then
        error("udp: truncated", 0)
    end
    local size = integer(data, 4, 2)
    if size < 8 or size > #data then
        error("udp: bad length " .. size, 0)
    end
    local result, first, second, checksum = layer(), integer(data, 0, 2), integer(data, 2, 2), integer(data, 6, 2)
    result:set("udp.srcport", first)
    result:set("udp.dstport", second)
    result:set("udp.length", size)
    result:set("udp.checksum", checksum)
    result:set("udp.checksum.status", checksum == 0 and "none" or network.checksum(pseudo(source, destination, 17, size) .. data:sub(1, size)))
    if first == 53 or second == 53 then
        result:forward("dns", data:sub(9, size))
    else
        result.remaining = data:sub(9, size)
    end
    return result
end
local option_lengths = {[2] = {[4] = true}, [3] = {[3] = true}, [4] = {[2] = true}, [5] = {[10] = true, [18] = true, [26] = true, [34] = true}, [8] = {[10] = true}}
local function options(data, result)
    local index = 1
    while index <= #data do
        local kind = data:byte(index)
        if kind == 0 then
            result:add("tcp.option", "EOL")
            return
        end
        if kind == 1 then
            result:add("tcp.option", "NOP")
            index = index + 1
        else
            local size = data:byte(index + 1) or 0
            if size < 2 or index + size - 1 > #data or option_lengths[kind] and not option_lengths[kind][size] then
                result:set("tcp.options.malformed", true)
                return
            end
            local body, text = data:sub(index + 2, index + size - 1), "kind " .. kind .. " len " .. size
            if kind == 2 then
                local value = integer(body, 0, 2)
                result:set("tcp.options.mss", value)
                text = "MSS " .. value
            elseif kind == 3 then
                result:set("tcp.options.wscale", body:byte(1))
                text = "WS " .. body:byte(1)
            elseif kind == 4 then
                text = "SACK_PERM"
            elseif kind == 5 then
                local pieces = {"SACK"}
                for offset = 0, #body - 1, 8 do
                    pieces[#pieces + 1] = " " .. integer(body, offset, 4) .. "-" .. integer(body, offset + 4, 4)
                end
                text = table.concat(pieces)
            elseif kind == 8 then
                text = "TS " .. integer(body, 0, 4) .. " " .. integer(body, 4, 4)
            end
            result:add("tcp.option", text)
            index = index + size
        end
    end
end
function M.tcp(data, source, destination)
    if #data < 20 then
        error("tcp: truncated header", 0)
    end
    local header = data:byte(13) // 16 * 4
    if header < 20 then
        error("tcp: bad header length " .. header, 0)
    end
    if header > #data then
        error("tcp: truncated header", 0)
    end
    local result, flags = layer(), data:byte(14)
    result:set("tcp.srcport", integer(data, 0, 2))
    result:set("tcp.dstport", integer(data, 2, 2))
    result:set("tcp.seq_raw", integer(data, 4, 4))
    result:set("tcp.hdr_len", header)
    result:set("tcp.flags", flags)
    local bit = 1
    for _, name in ipairs({"fin", "syn", "rst", "psh", "ack", "urg"}) do
        result:set("tcp.flags." .. name, flags // bit % 2)
        bit = bit * 2
    end
    result:set("tcp.window", integer(data, 14, 2))
    result:set("tcp.checksum", integer(data, 16, 2))
    result:set("tcp.checksum.status", network.checksum(pseudo(source, destination, 6, #data) .. data))
    result:set("tcp.urgent", integer(data, 18, 2))
    result:set("tcp.len", #data - header)
    if flags // 16 % 2 == 1 then
        result:set("tcp.ack_raw", integer(data, 8, 4))
    end
    options(data:sub(21, header), result)
    result.remaining = data:sub(header + 1)
    return result
end
return M
